# RocketNet v1.0.0 testing

<!-- Generated from docs/testing.sexp by tools/roadmap/render.py. Do not edit this file: edit the data and run `make testing`. -->

Every test RocketNet runs for v1.0.0, by platform and by transport. ✅ is landed on the release branch and shown green on that platform by its card or by CI; ❌ is not yet: in progress, not landed, or not carded. — does not apply. Each table's complete row is the share of ✅ among the cells that apply; in the transport table each transport counts once. Under each table, every ❌ names the card behind it, or no card.
